items.quote: And Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.
items.claim: Moses chose able men from Israel and appointed them as hierarchical administrators (heads, rulers of thousands, hundreds, fifties, and tens) over the people
items.object: able men; heads over the people; rulers of thousands, hundreds, fifties, tens
